messages.content: The picture is self explanatory 🙂
Huh

Vikander on 24 ioniq5
Driving majority on hwy. Hugging and at times crossing left solid line when on fast lane. No issues when on center or right lanes. Once when on right most lane with solid lines, I accidentally hit right signal and car started steering right.

Extremely brief local driving and  always ignored red/stop signs
First highway drive this morning. Stayed perfectly centered. Did get a lot of quick/short ping ponging with the wheel while going straight. Back roads hugs left line.
Try a fresh calibration on good lane lines
Alright. I’ll report back after work.

Re calibrated 2x on the way home, just to make sure I had good lines. It was much less this time, but still was present at times. Not un usuable or anything. Do these models learn locally or are they only updated when you guys update them?

Just switched back to this from KerryGold.   Lateral - big difference, far more authoritative and actually starts turning the wheel soon enough to successfully make more turns (at higher speed/lateral accel).    Not sure the long is as good but it's still decent.
Kerrygold, fof, vff , vfof series are all traditional simulator trained where vikander, tr, dtr, are MLSIM trained 😁
Very good to know!  Thumbs up for MLSIM
How is this model on highway vs TR7?
Doesn’t shake you from left to right violently when going above 70mph haha
Is live learning steer delay to be left on or off
I've had a better experience with it off and nnlc on.
That’s up to you. I have it off personally because it converges higher than I would like so off drives better on my car
It’s a live toggle so drive a couple min in both on and off and see for yourself which one you like better
Well this model does go full send into the corners to the point of almost losing control entirely so that's kind of hilarious
Full exp mode?
Just normal mode
Usually where VTSC would slow down to a crawl this does the opposite
Chill mode doesn’t have curve handling (vtsc, mtsc, )in -new added back yet
It's more fun with it out

After driving a bunch of the newest, I went back to this model.  Wow, authoritative lateral - impressive.   It made turns none of recent TR or DTR did.   I guess the long isn't the best though.   If only...

Best model I've used yet. Feels the closest to stock lfa when it's conditions are met. First and only model that managed my entire commute.

Minor wobbles ,but the lines are not well done or straight here .so ..like stock lfa..it wobbles of it keeps center. Made me feel comfortable that it was actually aware of itself
Well ..I retract. Hit curbs twice today.
Luckily low speed
Low speed left bends seem to be it's problem. Or a tuning problem. Or the fact the curb is quite large and at a 45 degree angle
Found the same and changed to VegFoF v2 and much better.
Thanks. I'll definitely try that

I've been doing things I probably shouldn't in response to it. Like adding curb avoidance code and stuff. The whole drive felt more confident, but confident to a fault. I grabbed more of the wheel this time.

I'll try a different model. Hopefully one of them will match hda2 for lane centering. it gets pretty scary sometimes on these models
I drove it today on some pretty abrupt curves and it tracked almost perfectly.  Still liking this model in particular for its lateral.  Long may not be the best so far, but not problematic either.
well I feel like a jerk. I was reviewing footage.. and wouldn't you know it, my cord was crossing the middle of the camera. its a wonder it did so well at all, it was very blocked.
This is so far the Best model that no one talks about
A lot of models are car dependent, so one model may work great for some, but run horribly for others
Comma.ai always does their best to make the best model for all vehicles though
Tried this today again for fun.   Steers very nice, though likes to try and kiss the lead's bumper at a stop.  SL2 and SL2V2 do not have this problem.
Does SL2 or SL2V2 have as good of steering as Vikander? Vikander currently has the best Lat of any model I've tried.
I’ve tested both today. Still think vik is a little better
Slsv2 seems to be ok going over lines
SL2V2 steering seems about as good as Vikander.
I found sl2v2 is just as good if not better than vik
Lat or Long? I tried both and felt that Sl2 v2 would randomly go over the lines on highways when going around a wide bend. Vik still seems to be more stable in the lane
But I use the GV70 stock ACC so never used the model long for highway driving
Maybe I need to let the SL2v2 run longer?
still using this after a month+. some bumper kissing for sure. i appreciate the lane centering after trying a few models that like to hug one side
